en.title: Riyadh Metro
en.locFar: The nearest station, {s}, is about {k} km away. A taxi may be easier.
en.locDenied: Location access is off. Allow it in the browser settings to find the nearest station.
en.locFail: Couldn't get your location. Try again or type a place.
en.hintNone: Where do you want to go? Type a place or a station, or tap one of the popular places. Old station names work too: Olaya.
en.hintOne: Now choose the other end: type a station or place above, tap a popular place, or tap a station on the map.
en.hintSame: Start and destination are the same.
en.hintBoth: {a} and {b} are both next to {s} station, so you can walk between them.
en.noRoute: No route found between these two. Try another station or place.
en.arrive: Leave now, arrive around {t1}–{t2} Riyadh time
en.wClosed: {m} is closed now and opens at {t}.
en.wCloses: {m} closes at {t}, so you may not finish this trip tonight.
en.copyFallback: Select and copy the link below
en.qrFail: QR code could not load. Use the link above.
en.waitPlatform: Wait on the platform for a train towards {d} · ~{n} min
en.onFootOut: ~{n} min on foot, outside the stations
en.noWalkData: Short walk from the station; we don't have a reliable time for this one
en.infoP: One ticket covers any number of rides and transfers for 2 hours, on the metro and Riyadh buses. Children under 6 travel free with an adult. Pay with a darb card, the darb app or a contactless bank card. Trains have First Class, Family and Singles sections. Hours change during Ramadan and on holidays.
en.foot: Unofficial map. All times are estimates (trains about every 4–10 min). Walking times are rough. Station names as of 2026.
en.nothing: Nothing found. Try a station name or a place like Kingdom Centre.
en.estNote: Estimate, not real-time. The lower figure is travel only; the higher adds typical waiting for each train.
en.wNotRunning: {m} isn't running at {t0}; it opens at {t}.
en.hoursNote: These are published service hours, not last-train times. Depending on direction, the last train through a station can leave well before closing; late in the evening check the station screens or the darb app.
en.whereFrom: Where can I go from here?
en.arriveFrom: Leave at {t0}, arrive around {t1}–{t2} Riyadh time
en.visitNote: Time spent at each place is not included.
en.stopoverWarn: Leave plenty of time to get back to the airport, go through security and board. Check your airline's advice before leaving the airport.
en.attrib: There is no public timetable, so run times are estimated from the official track map (RCRC open data) and station positions.
en.reportNotSet: No feedback address has been set up for this site yet. You can copy the details below and send them to the site owner.
en.fareNote: First class SAR {f} · one ticket for 2 hours, transfers and buses included
en.n_bus: Not within walking distance of the metro: from {s} continue by bus or taxi.
en.n_t34: Terminals 3 and 4 share this station; allow 5–10 min through the walkways, depending on your gate.
en.w_t12: a short walk to the terminal and arrivals hall
